title: Send sample invoices from the demo guide directly
summary: The Payables Agent demo guide now sends sample invoices immediately when selecting the email option, rather than deferring the send until setup is saved, ensuring invoices are sent regardless of the order of operations.
key_points: Sample invoices are sent synchronously when the email option is chosen in the demo guide
Send flags are cleared after invoices are sent to prevent duplicate sends when saving setup
The final success screen only displays after the email has actually been transmitted
The change removes the dependency on the order in which users perform setup steps
quote: Now the guide sends the sample invoices right when you choose the email option, so it no longer depends on the order of steps.
